name: Websites - Authorized - IT and Security Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized IT and Security tooling domains — populate with sanctioned IT-ops and security platforms (e.g., okta.com / acme.okta.com, crowdstrike.com, jamfcloud.com, jira.acme.com, sumologic.com). Drives the Authorized split on D1060 (Internal IT/Security) and is negated to define the Unauthorized IT/Security surface on D1061. Exclusions: do not add unapproved vendor tools; do not add public vulnerability databases without justification; restrict to your active security stack.
